# 1on1 Marcus - 2026-08-26

**Time:** 60 min, Wednesday 11 AM
**Person:** [[Marcus Bell]]

## What Marcus brought up

**Cut-over retro.** Retro was yesterday. Eight days on the new pipeline, zero missed cutoffs. He's proud and he should be. The thing he wanted to talk about wasn't the pipeline though; it was the shadow period. Two weeks of nightly diffs with him personally signing off each morning. He doesn't want to do that again. Next time, he wants the diff review to be a rotation from day one.

**KYC.** Existing-user migration from Persona to Alloy closes Friday (Aug 29). Last batch is the hard cases: users with stale documents. Hana is reviewing the edge cases. He thinks it lands. Then he wants to never hear the word "migration" again.

**He's tired.** Said it plainly, which he doesn't usually. ACH cut-over, KYC, the weekly Pillar sync, interviews, and on-call backstop since April. He hasn't had a full week off since February.

## What I brought up

**Time off.** Take a full week in September, after KYC closes. I'll cover the Pillar sync personally. He said yes. I'll believe it when his status says OOO.

**VP Eng search.** Hollis Partners was engaged yesterday; Aleks approved starting before close because the term-sheet conversations are going well. I told Marcus the explicit goal: someone who takes operational load (incident process, on-call health, cross-team coordination) off him and off me. He was visibly relieved. Then asked whether he'd report to the VP Eng. Yes. He was fine with it, as long as it's someone who "has actually been paged."

**The sweep job.** Sarah flagged that the Rails money-moving jobs still have no clear owner ([[1on1 Sarah - 2026-08-05]]). I asked whether the round-up sweep belongs on the new pipeline. He said yes, but not this quarter. Agreed, not this quarter. Writing down that we made that call knowingly.

Risk: round-up sweep stays on Rails/Sidekiq without idempotency keys through Q3.

**Comp.** Repeated the commitment from May. Post-close, he's first.

## Commitments

- [x] Marcus: close the KYC existing-user migration by Aug 29
- [x] Marcus: write the Sidekiq ACH decommission plan once the 30-day hold ends Sep 17
- Marcus: take a full week off in September (he took three days)
- [x] Me: cover the Pillar weekly sync while he's out

## Read on Marcus

Proud, exhausted, and running on the momentum of finishing things. That's the dangerous part. When the big project ends, people like Marcus fill the space with the next thing instead of resting.

## Personal note

I wrote in May that Marcus was the most stable person on the team ([[Founder Therapy Notes 2026-05-12]]). True then. I've been leaning on that for four months. Stability isn't infinite capacity.
